title: JUST ONE MORE | The Phone Ate His Nights
description:
His dad works night shifts so he can pass one exam. Every night, a kind voice tells him: just one more video.
Then, at 4 AM, his phone dies, and something looks back at him from the black screen.

When kindness stops working, something else takes over.

Subscribe for the next film.
